name: ppt_qutrit_bell_state_partial_transpose_invariant
lines: ⊢ ∀ (a b c d : Fin 3), ppt_qutrit_bell_state (a, b) (c, d) = ppt_qutrit_bell_state (c, b) (a, d)
⊢ ppt_qutrit_bell_state (a, b) (c, d) = ppt_qutrit_bell_state (c, b) (a, d)
